verdict.rationale: Passing agent identity into risk scoring is a fair question for a fraud-decision product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions agentic-payment protocols, signed agent tokens, or delegated spending scopes as Radar signals. Generic custom rules on 'supported attributes' and Radar Sessions are adjacent building blocks, not a first-class agent-identity signal.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass verified agent identity — agentic-payment protocols, signed agent tokens, delegated spending scopes — into the risk decision as a first-class signal
